purpose: Adjudicate a representative cross-section of the exact-upstream phuryn/pm-skills catalog without treating its 68 Skill paths as one admission unit, rewriting payloads, or converting static quality signals into installation, behavior, or value claims.

source.materializationObservation: Exact-revision clone and Git object acquisition succeeded, but detached checkout could not create .git/index.lock on the Windows review root. The pinned commit and tree were verified and all reviewed bytes were read directly from Git blobs; this is a materialization limitation, not a candidate failure.

cohort.selectionBasis: Representative low-dependency collaboration and software-delivery methods plus dependency, overlap, opinionated-template, and high-stakes counterexamples.

representativeSkills.name: intended-vs-implemented
representativeSkills.distinctCoverage: A structured three-way comparison of intended behavior, implemented behavior, and the gaps between them.
representativeSkills.reason: The method is relevant to semantic-authority continuity, but its own workflow assumes the shipping-artifacts layer and therefore is not a dependency-complete standalone admission unit.

representativeSkills.name: shipping-artifacts
representativeSkills.distinctCoverage: Reviewable intent, test, and delivery artifacts for AI-assisted shipping.
representativeSkills.reason: A Skill-only CC Switch installation would not supply the assumed plugin commands, and the fixed documentation layout requires a repository-level compatibility decision.

representativeSkills.name: strategy-red-team
representativeSkills.permissionAndDataBoundary: Reasoning-only by default; optional cross-model critique remains separately task-, data-, cost-, and authority-bound.
representativeSkills.distinctCoverage: Steelman, failure assumptions, falsification signals, and cheapest validation tests in one compact strategy review.
representativeSkills.reason: Self-contained and low executable surface, but overlap and actual incremental value must be tested against existing critique routes before admission.

representativeSkills.name: pre-mortem
representativeSkills.reason: The useful pre-mortem idea is substantially covered by the stronger red-team candidate, while automatic saving and a non-neutral severity default increase governance cost.

representativeSkills.name: prioritize-assumptions
representativeSkills.reason: The selected payload is not dependency-complete as a standalone Skill and its simplified scoring rules need comparison before composition.

representativeSkills.name: interview-script
representativeSkills.permissionAndDataBoundary: Script generation is local; recording, participant data, outreach, storage, and analysis require separate consent, privacy, and retention boundaries.
representativeSkills.distinctCoverage: Past-behavior interview design, anti-leading-question checks, and explicit recording-permission guidance.
representativeSkills.reason: Self-contained and method-specific, but real participant use and incremental value remain unproved.

representativeSkills.name: opportunity-solution-tree
representativeSkills.permissionAndDataBoundary: Consumes user research or product evidence supplied under the task boundary; does not itself authorize collection or external data access.
representativeSkills.distinctCoverage: Links outcomes, evidence-backed opportunities, solution options, and assumption tests in a traceable discovery tree.
representativeSkills.reason: Self-contained and distinct enough for a bounded comparison, but usefulness depends on real research evidence and is not established statically.

representativeSkills.name: create-prd
representativeSkills.reason: Useful as a reference template, but broad default use would add a rigid artifact model and duplicate existing intake and planning routes.

representativeSkills.name: test-scenarios
representativeSkills.reason: The scenario categories are useful reference material but do not yet demonstrate incremental value over current QA and testing routes.

representativeSkills.name: user-stories
representativeSkills.reason: A conventional fixed user-story framework is not a universal requirement representation and does not justify another active route without a task-bound comparison.

representativeSkills.name: market-sizing
representativeSkills.permissionAndDataBoundary: Requests current web research and source use; data access and browsing remain task-bound.
representativeSkills.reason: An OpenAI-curated runtime Skill with the exact capability name is currently visible. Presence is not behavior proof, but existing-official-first blocks duplicative third-party admission until a real insufficiency is evidenced.

representativeSkills.name: draft-nda
representativeSkills.reason: A disclaimer and legal-review labels do not validate jurisdictional accuracy, fitness, or safe reuse of a legal agreement generator.

representativeSkills.name: privacy-policy
representativeSkills.reason: The body mixes time-sensitive legal claims, product-practice assertions, and publication-ready output; admission requires current authoritative legal review and a bound data-practice verification surface.

portfolioOverlapSnapshot.snapshotMeaning: Name and route presence are overlap inputs only; they do not prove live loading, instruction delivery, behavior, or value.

managerBoundary.nextSafeAction: Keep the exact source as inactive review evidence. Before any CC Switch registration or installation, finish dependency and overlap review for the selected comparison cohort and bind a reversible default-disabled behavior-comparison protocol.
